headline: UltraTech Cement surpasses 2 gigawatts of green energy captive capacity
hook: First in India to hit 2GW milestone
summary: UltraTech Cement has become the first cement company in India to reach over 2 gigawatts of green energy capacity for captive use. This milestone reflects the company's ongoing transition toward renewable energy sources to power its manufacturing operations. For Indian retail investors, expanding green energy capacity reduces long-term operational and power costs in an energy-intensive sector.
why_it_matters: Lower power costs improve long-term cement margins.
winners_losers: UltraTech gains / traditional power suppliers hurt

headline: UltraTech Cement clarifies market rumours under exchange norms
summary: UltraTech Cement has responded to a regulatory requirement for rumour verification under Regulation 30(11) of SEBI LODR. The company informed the stock exchange regarding circulating market speculations. Such disclosures help curb volatility and protect retail investors from unverified news. Investors should track official company clarifications before reacting to market chatter.
whats_next: Official company clarification filing on NSE and BSE
why_it_matters: Clarification on rumors prevents knee-jerk moves in your cement holdings.
